description: This file implements a Kafka connection validator class, `KafkaValidator`, which extends an abstract validator for protocols. It performs validation tasks for Kafka connection configurations, including URI scheme validation, target address validation (topics, keys, partitions), and specific Kafka configuration validation. The class provides singleton access and is part of a package related to Kafka messaging connectivity within a broader service framework. It is specifically tailored to validate Kafka connection details like topics, partitions, and security schemes.

classes.name: KafkaValidator
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for validating Kafka connection configurations, including topics, partitions, keys, and security schemes. It extends the `AbstractProtocolValidator` and enforces specific validation rules for Kafka connections.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the connection type associated with this validator, which is `KAFKA`.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation steps on the given connection, headers, and actor system, including URI scheme, source, target, payload mappings, and specific Kafka configs.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target component of the connection, including address placeholders and correctness.
